findings.title: No automated regression coverage verifies SQL expressions stay disabled
findings.body: This security fix changes the SQL query path to reject requests regardless of the `sqlExpressions` feature flag, but the PR adds no test covering that behavior. Add tests that submit a SQL expression with the flag both enabled and disabled and assert that no SQL command is constructed or executed; the legacy `NewSQLCommand`/`UnmarshalSQLCommand` path should also be covered because it does not pass through this reader. Without coverage, a future feature-toggle cleanup or restoration of the DB implementation can silently re-enable the RCE/LFI attack surface.
